text(OpportunityLineItem.Opportunity.Owner.LBR_Legal_Entity__c) <> 'Law Business Research (Asia) Ltd.'),
'SIUS',
if(
AND(
OpportunityLineItem.Opportunity.Invoice_Contact__r.MailingCountry= "United States",
OpportunityLineItem.Contract_Type_Code__c="SUB",

text(OpportunityLineItem.Opportunity.Owner.LBR_Legal_Entity__c) <> 'Law Business Research (Asia) Ltd.'),
'SCUS',

)
)
)
